item.title: Migration of Home Gateway Solution to IOT Platform | Sasken
item.description: Sasken will enable the customer to port their proprietary software on the world's most popular silicon platform targeting the booming home automation segment. This will enable the customer's home gateway solution to work with a larger spectrum of domestic appliances due to enhanced connectivity options. Sasken's solution provides a superior mobile user interface that significantly simplifies the configurability and management of domestic appliances.

item.title: Enabled Android Security Management Releases | Sasken
item.description: Sasken recently enabled a reputed American multinational conglomerate with timely Security Management Releases (SMR) for their devices running on the Android OS. The team was responsible for end-to-end management of SMR releases for devices running on Android 11 and 12 powered by the chipsets. The scope of work also involved addressing diverse business needs by providing necessary software modifications. These efforts ensured the growth of the customer’s presence in America, Europe, and Asia with a diverse range of devices.

item.title: Sasken Buzz: Won Electric Vehicle Project in Europe | Sasken
item.description: Sasken’s chip to cognition capabilities remain a crucial differentiator A recent win in the electric vehicle OEM for their newly launched scooters is a case in point. Sasken built an initial working model, taking on the full responsibility for product development. By leveraging our expertise in delivering firmware, RTOS, kernel BSP, Android middleware, build integration, and HMI, we are supporting the delivery of an unparalleled ADAS experience with intuitive HMI designs. The team is also developing acoustic vehicle alerting systems in compliance with EU regulations. Sasken is also helping to accelerate the deployment of their electric vehicle charging infrastructure across India.

item.title: Sasken Buzz: Won 5G-based Telematics Platform Project | Sasken
item.description: Sasken enjoys the reputation of being a leader in delivering solutions in the product engineering and digital segments across multiple verticals. We are partnering with a Tier 1 supplier of automotive telematics platforms in developing their Network Access Device (NAD). We are building a solution on the next-gen 5G chipset and developing this platform from the ground up, incorporating customizable and cost-effective design that can adapt to changes in technology. Sasken’s expertise in telematics, modem and Linux drivers, as well as middleware, played a crucial role in being identified as the partner of choice. Sasken is enabling the customer to launch the first-of-its-kind telematics platform with 5G support.

item.title: Sasken won Android Upgrade Project for Ultra-rugged Devices | Sasken
item.description: Sasken, a leader in providing Android solutions for numerous global partners, is powering a Japanese ultra-rugged device manufacturer to manage timely Android upgrades for a family of products.  We are the trusted partner to manage end-to-end responsibilities for Android-powered devices built on the latest chipset platforms. In addition, Sasken develops applications and frameworks to address the needs of Japanese telecom service providers to help the smart device OEM gain better market traction.

item.description: Sasken is entrusted with a New Product Introduction (NPI) for Android-based intelligent devices. item.title: Sasken Received Green Award for Sustainability Initiatives | Sasken
item.description: Sasken, as an organization, has always taken great pride in the diverse nature of its sustainability initiatives across all geographies. These ecologically sustainable ventures recently came to Beautiful Bengaluru's attention, and Sasken was awarded a Green Award for March 2021. Beautiful Bengaluru (BB) is a local chapter working towards ensuring the preservation of Bengaluru as a city by focusing on keeping it clean, green, and safe. They have partnered with communities, corporate entities, educational institutes, and government bodies to work towards the city’s betterment. BB was impressed by the diverse array of Sasken initiatives that were carried out as an organization. This includes organic waste composting, plastic elimination on campus, the in-house biogas plant, and the various water-saving and carbon-neutral initiatives at our corporate campus. This genuine recognition from a reputed organization is a testament and further encouragement for Sasken’s continuous efforts to be an ecologically responsible corporate citizen.

item.title: Digital Transformation Project for Quality Assurance | Sasken
item.description: Sasken’s expertise in the digital domain has stood the testimony of organizations that are at the forefront of the digital transformation era. We have delivered state-of-the-art and unique solutions for customers across the globe. Our competencies in digital technologies have recently ensured an engagement to accelerate feature development. We are enhancing the customer captive portal by delivering high-quality scalable and modular code and enabling timely releases to partners for pilot testing.  Our proven ability in Digital Web Application, Front-End & Back-end development and automation testing were key considerations that resulted in Sasken being the preferred partner. The scope also includes offshore testing services, creating test automation frameworks, enhanced verification, bug triage, and validation to ensure quality assurance compliance.
